# BasicDetailPage: its buttons, fields and dropdowns

What the crawl saw on pages of this type that a visitor can use (links are in
ai/GLOSSARY.md), read only: nothing was clicked, typed or sent. Each locator matched exactly one element
on the page it was read from. Those it trusts are already in `BasicDetailElements`, each with the method
that uses it; a fragile one (its locator counts positions) is not, and has a line to paste into the
**elements** YOURS block once checked against a saved page (ai/recipes/add-an-element.md). Controls on most pages (a footer form) are in
controls/Everywhere.md. Not listed: anything that appears only after a click, behind a login, or
after a form is sent; ask for a saved page of that.

## In the page

- **"Move mouse here"**: button. Seen on 1 of 2 crawled pages (e.g. /basic/hover). In `BasicDetailElements` as `MOVE_MOUSE_HERE_BUTTON`: `click().moveMouseHere()`.
- **"Shipping info"**: button. Seen on 1 of 2 crawled pages (e.g. /basic/hover). In `BasicDetailElements` as `SHIPPING_INFO_BUTTON`: `click().shippingInfo()`.
- **"Click me"**: button. Seen on 1 of 2 crawled pages (e.g. /basic/buttons). In `BasicDetailElements` as `CLICK_ME_BUTTON`: `click().clickMe()`.
- **"Primary action"**: button. Seen on 1 of 2 crawled pages (e.g. /basic/buttons). In `BasicDetailElements` as `PRIMARY_ACTION_BUTTON`: `click().primaryAction()`.
- **"Disabled button"**: button. Seen on 1 of 2 crawled pages (e.g. /basic/buttons). In `BasicDetailElements` as `DISABLED_BUTTON`: `click().disabled()`.
- **"Double click me"**: button. Seen on 1 of 2 crawled pages (e.g. /basic/buttons). In `BasicDetailElements` as `DOUBLE_CLICK_ME_BUTTON`: `click().doubleClickMe()`.
- **"Right click me"**: button. Seen on 1 of 2 crawled pages (e.g. /basic/buttons). In `BasicDetailElements` as `RIGHT_CLICK_ME_BUTTON`: `click().rightClickMe()`.
